# TuitionBase

> TuitionBase is an OFSTED-registered tuition provider running small-group classes (maximum 5 students) in North and East London. It teaches Maths, English, Biology, Chemistry and Physics from KS1 to A Level (including GCSE and IGCSE) and specialises in 11+ preparation.

## Key facts

- Subjects: Maths, English, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, 11+ preparation
- Levels: Key Stage 1, 2 and 3, GCSE, IGCSE, A Level
- Exam boards: all major exam boards are covered
- Class size: small groups, maximum 5 students
- Registered childcare provider; childcare vouchers accepted
- Universal Credit can pay up to 85% of registered childcare costs (maximum £1,071.09 per month for one child, £1,836.16 per month for two or more children)
- Class times: Saturday and Sunday, 10:00-14:30
- Phone: 0203 633 4822
- WhatsApp: +44 7932 391843
- Email: info@tuitionbase.co.uk
- Website: https://tuitionbase.co.uk

## Centres (all OFSTED registered)

- TuitionBase Enfield: Oasis Academy Hadley, South Street, Enfield EN3 4PX (OFSTED EY545755)
- TuitionBase Edmonton: The Latymer School, Haselbury Road, London N9 9TN (OFSTED EY552284)
- TuitionBase Forest Gate: Forest Gate Community School, Forest Lane, London E7 9BB (OFSTED EY553940)
